facts.fact: The INSD strategic plan says the statistics law in force is Loi n°036-2021/AN of 6 December 2021 on the organisation and regulation of statistical activities, which governs the national statistical system and makes the INSD the central statistics body.
facts.system: Loi n°036-2021/AN portant organisation et réglementation des activités statistiques (2021)

facts.fact: The plan says decree No. 2025-1095/PF/PRIM/MEF of 26 August 2025, on the attributions, organisation and operation of the national statistical system, was adopted in application of the 2021 statistics law.
facts.system: Loi n°036-2021/AN portant organisation et réglementation des activités statistiques (2021)
